findings.issue: The maxIterations row says: 'Under --depth-mode=expansive a `default` budget is resized after the seed step to `min(24, max(10, 2·c·(S + maxDepth − 1)))`, with S the depth-1 nodes the seed admitted and c = 1; any other source is kept as given'. It does not limit this to single-executor runs. In a fan-out run the parent budget is never resized. fanout-run.cjs expansiveLineageBudgets (lines 332-350) sizes each lineage that has no matrix iterations value from its own round-robin share of the open depth-1 seed nodes (partitionFrontierNodes, lines 312-322), not from the whole seed. The floor is 12 for a native lineage and the workflow default of 10 for a CLI lineage, and a lineage dealt no seed node runs at that floor. Only a matrix iterations value is kept as given. The yaml's fan-out seed step (deep-research.yaml line 359) passes no --max-iterations-source, and step_fanout_spawn_cli passes no max-iterations value to fanout-run.cjs. Its FANOUT_FLAGS list (lines 30-36) has no maxIterations entry. So a --max-iterations flag or marker is not kept as given for fan-out lineages. A fan-out reader gets the wrong set of nodes, the wrong floor and the wrong rule for which sources are kept.
